interpretation: No computed candidate exceeds the GB 3095—2026 transitional secondary annual reference of 30 µg/m³ on the CHAP 2023-2025 three-year mean or 2025 annual proxy. Four candidates exceed 25 µg/m³ on the 2023-2025 proxy; this is a forward-looking verification priority for the 2031 standard, not a current failure. Modelled grid values are not official monitoring compliance determinations. Nine candidates remain geometry-pending and are not counted.
caveats: The 2023-2025 three-year mean is constructed from annual CHAP modelled values; it is not the official station-based three-year sliding evaluation under HJ 663—2026.
WorldPop population weighting and provisional county geometry are spatial proxies.
The former 35 µg/m³ GB 3095—2012 annual secondary limit was superseded on 2026-03-01; it is retained only as historical context.
No formal exclusion or grade change is made from this correction.
